# SYNESIS_E065 — Error

## Description

PROJECT block without a TEMPLATE declaration.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The project file declares no template. The template is required
  — it defines the validation rules for every annotation in the project.
  Without it, the compiler cannot check whether the annotations are correct.
  Add to the PROJECT block:
    TEMPLATE "file_name.synt"
```
